what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Syria in Libya: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4723 Syrian asylum seekers in Libya, 3.1% of all asylum seekers from Syria.
Refugees from Syria, a separate group, live mostly in Türkiye, Germany, Lebanon and Jordan.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria in every year from 2011 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Syria from 2013 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2006 at 8 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 23173, at the end of 2018.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2023, and the figure was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Libya.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Libya only.
